subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff — schedule & sequencing for procurement + security
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@atlascloud.com>; procurement-team@atlascloud.com
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff — schedule & sequencing for procurement + security

Hi Sophie / Atlas procurement team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood — excited to get the procurement & onboarding cadence in motion. To keep the kickoff focused and to minimize wasted calendar time across your procurement, security, and engineering stakeholders, we usually run a two-part intake:

1) Commercial + procurement alignment (30–45 min): pricing, SOW/PO timeline, invoicing contact, required legal redlines, and procurement checklist.
2) Technical intake & security requirements (60 min): architecture, data flow, network firewall/IPs, SOC2 evidence mapping, and access handoffs for the SE/infra teams.

Proposed availability windows (all US-PDT):
- Tue 29 Jun: 09:00–11:30 or 14:00–16:00
- Wed 30 Jun: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00

Can you confirm who should attend from your side for each session (procurement, legal, security, platform eng)? If you prefer, we can combine into one 90-minute session but we recommend separating to limit cross-attendee time.

Attached is our vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf and a SOC2 evidence request spreadsheet so you can see the items typically requested.

Next steps I propose once you confirm attendees: I (AE) will schedule the procurement call and loop in billing/legal as needed; Sergio (SE) will schedule the technical intake and prepare a short architecture diagram and required firewall IPs list. Hannah from RevOps will track PO timelines and invoice contacts.

Thanks,

--
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri_yom@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (PDF), SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@atlascloud.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement-team@atlascloud.com; Mark Reynolds <m.reynolds@atlascloud.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding kickoff — schedule & sequencing for procurement + security

Hi Priyom,

Thanks — this looks good. For the procurement session, I'll attend along with Carla (procurement lead) and Joe (legal). For technical intake, Mark (platform eng) and Nina (security) should join.

We prefer splitting into two sessions. Of the proposed windows, Wednesday 30 Jun 10:00–12:00 for technical and Tue 29 Jun 14:00–14:45 for procurement work for us. I can confirm final attendees by end of day Monday.

Also: we use a short internal onboarding form for vendors — I'll attach our vendor_requirements.pdf in the follow-up and will share a preferred PO cadence (monthly/quarterly).

Best,
Sophie
VP, Platform Operations — AtlasCloud
sophie.lang@atlascloud.com

Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding kickoff — schedule & sequencing for procurement + security

Thanks, Priyom and Sophie — I can take the technical intake on Wed 30 Jun. For prep, could Mark and Nina share any current architecture diagrams or a short network topology (VPC peering / egress IPs)? We usually surface the following in the first technical session:

- High-level architecture diagram + expected traffic patterns
- Data types (PII, PHI, logs) and retention expectations
- Required firewall/IP allowlist for outbound API calls and callback endpoints
- Any compliance docs you already have (SOC2, ISO) so we can map evidence requests

I’ll prepare a 10–15 slide focused deck and a one-page checklist to keep the call on track. If you want me to run any preliminary connectivity tests, share a staging endpoint and an on-call contact.

— Sergio
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com

Subject: Scheduled: Procurement alignment (30m) — Tue 29 Jun 14:00 PDT / Technical intake (60m) — Wed 30 Jun 10:00 PDT

Hi all — I’ve scheduled both sessions and sent Google Calendar invites:

1) Procurement alignment — Tue 29 Jun, 14:00–14:45 PDT
2) Technical intake — Wed 30 Jun, 10:00–11:00 PDT

Invites include the initial agendas and the two attachments I shared previously. Carla / Joe / Mark / Nina — please accept when you can. If any timing conflicts come up, flag here and we’ll propose alternates; we’d prefer to keep the two-session cadence but can collapse if necessary.

Hannah — looping you to track PO/invoice contact and to confirm expected PO lead time.

Thanks,
Priyom

Attachments: redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf, SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx

>

Appreciate the clear runbook — I confirmed with Nina that we can provide the internal architecture diagram and a staging endpoint by EOD Friday. For procurement: Carla will push a PO draft next week and legal is reviewing the standard redlines. We'll keep you posted.

Thanks,
Mark
